title: Logic Operators
description:
## Logic Operators
Rust has the standard logic operators for combining conditions:

- `&&` - AND (both must be true)
- `||` - OR (at least one must be true)
- `!` - NOT (flips true to false)

```rust
let a: bool = true;
let b: bool = false;
println!("{}", a && b);  // false
println!("{}", a || b);  // true
println!("{}", !a);      // false
```

You can also use comparison operators:
- `==`, `!=`, `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=`

```rust
let x: i32 = 10;
println!("{}", x > 5 && x < 20);  // true
```
